name: r6b_tou_bank_lead_follows_primary__v4
description: A time-of-use peak starts at 16:15. The house is at 72 F and banking toward 68 F means 4 F of cooling. v3's learned rate is slow (1 F per hour); v4's fitted AC is a realistic 3.5 F per hour (2.8 F in the first hour through the house's hidden mass), and on a 90 F afternoon the house leaks heat back in at 0.05 of the gap per hour. Primary engine v4 (v3 is the live comparison engine): since Issue #1517 the lead accounts for that leak, so the bank window opens at 13:42 (153 minutes before the peak; the leak-unaware formula said 14:24), the plan says so, and the thermostat is told 68 F at the 13:45 check, not at the next half-hour cycle.

events.note: The 14:20 plan cycle (the v4 bank window has not started).
End of run: three minutes after the 14:25 check.

assertions.reason: Before the window opens nothing is banked.
Between the 13:00 setup and the window start nothing more is written (the comfort setpoint 76 F was told at 13:00).
The window the plan shows starts 153 minutes before the 16:15 peak on v4's rate with the house's leak (Issue #1517; the leak-unaware lead said 14:24, a v3 rate 12:15, the 45-minute default 15:30).
The thermostat is told 68 F at the first 5-minute check at or after the window start (13:44:59), with no comfort write before it, not at the 14:00 half-hour cycle.
The plan list names the same 13:42 start the thermostat acted on.

verdict.summary: The time-of-use bank opens by the primary engine (v4) rate, and the plan and the thermostat agree on when
verdict.expected_behavior: The house is banked when the peak starts: the lead covers the heat leaking in while the AC runs (Issue #1517). Re-derived 2026-11-11 with the owner's approval: the old 14:24 start (111 min) under-estimated the time on a 90 F afternoon; v4's own model of this house needs about 315 min (it also counts mass and sun), so 13:42 is closer but still not early enough - tracked separately.

source: synthetic: Issue #1230 R6b (primary prediction engine drives decisions), redesigned per the independent review; DP-11 pending, unsigned
